salesforce:query.doc:name: SF: query Order
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, OrderNumber, Status, Type, ActivatedDate, OpportunityId, AccountId, Account.Name, Account.IsTestAccount__c, NeonCRM_Modules__c, Create_SETUP_Jira__c FROM Order WHERE Id = ':id'

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "SELECT Id, OrderItemNumber, Quantity, Product2Id, Product2.Name, Product2.ProductCode, Product2.Product_Line__c, Product2.Sync_JIRA__c, Product2.Jira_Module_Value__c, " ++ "JIRA_SETUP_Issue__c, JIRA_SETUP_Error__c, JIRA_SETUP_Status__c, Neon_CRM_Instance_Created_Date__c, Create_SETUP_Jira__c " ++ "FROM OrderItem WHERE OrderId = ':orderId'" ++ (if ((vars.syncOnly default true) == true) " AND Product2.Sync_JIRA__c = true" else "") ++ (if (isEmpty(vars.productLine default "")) "" else " AND Product2.Product_Line__c = ':line'") ++ " ORDER BY OrderItemNumber"

salesforce:query.doc:name: SF: query Order Products
salesforce:query.salesforce:parameters: #[{ orderId: vars.orderId } ++ (if (isEmpty(vars.productLine default "")) {} else { line: vars.productLine })]

salesforce:query.doc:name: SF: query Additional Users
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE AccountId = ':accountId' AND Orientation_Participant__c = true ORDER BY Name

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" var o = vars.order fun blankAsNull(v) = if (v == null or isEmpty(trim(v as String))) null else v fun dateOnly(v) = if (v == null) null else ((v as Date) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd" }) // Booleans on related records (Product2.*, Account.*) arrive from the Salesforce connector as the strings "true"/"false" // (seen live 5 Oct 2026 on CloudHub); the contract is a real boolean fun bool(v) = if (v == null) false else (lower(v as String) == "true") --- { id: o.Id, orderNumber: o.OrderNumber, status: o.Status, "type": o.Type, activatedDate: if (o.ActivatedDate == null) null else (o.ActivatedDate as DateTime), opportunityId: o.OpportunityId, accountId: o.AccountId, account: { id: o.AccountId, name: o.Account.Name, isTestAccount: bool(o.Account.IsTestAccount__c) }, // Modules string built by Salesforce (Order.NeonCRM_Modules__c, requirements 7 Oct 2026) — null until the Order Flow fills it neonCrmModules: blankAsNull(o.NeonCRM_Modules__c), createSetupJira: bool(o.Create_SETUP_Jira__c), filter: { productLine: blankAsNull(vars.productLine), syncOnly: (vars.syncOnly default true) == true }, items: vars.itemRows map ((i) -> { id: i.Id, orderItemNumber: i.OrderItemNumber, quantity: if (i.Quantity == null) null else (i.Quantity as Number), productId: i.Product2Id, productName: i.Product2.Name, productCode: i.Product2.ProductCode, productLine: i.Product2.Product_Line__c, syncJira: bool(i.Product2.Sync_JIRA__c), // Jira Modules value of the product (Product2.Jira_Module_Value__c, e.g. "Events | Neon Events"); the Flow's qualification flag jiraModuleValue: blankAsNull(i.Product2.Jira_Module_Value__c), createSetupJira: bool(i.Create_SETUP_Jira__c), jiraSetupIssueKey: blankAsNull(i.JIRA_SETUP_Issue__c), jiraSetupError: i.JIRA_SETUP_Error__c, jiraSetupStatus: i.JIRA_SETUP_Status__c, instanceCreatedDate: dateOnly(i.Neon_CRM_Instance_Created_Date__c) }), additionalUsers: vars.contactRows map ((c) -> { id: c.Id, name: c.Name, email: c.Email }) }
